vars.query: MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE NOT (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]-() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)<-[:PredicateT]-() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->()-[:PredicateU]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() AND NOT (s)-[:PredicateOther]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() OR s.name = 'missing' MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT {enabled: $enabled}]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT {enabled: $enabled}]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (t:PredicateTarget) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() WITH s MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) RETURN count(*)
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) SET s.seen = true
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) SET r.seen = true
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) CREATE (c:PredicateCreated {name: t.name})

post_assertions.cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE NOT n:PredicateCreated RETURN n

vars.query: MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) CREATE (s)-[:PredicateCreatedLink {name: t.name}]->(t)
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) SET s.seen = true RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) SET r.seen = true RETURN s.name, t.name
MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) CREATE (c:PredicateCreated {name: t.name}) RETURN s.name, t.name

post_assertions.cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE NOT n:PredicateCreated RETURN n

vars.query: MATCH (s:PredicateSource) WHERE (s)-[:PredicateT]->() MATCH (s)-[r:PredicateR]->(t) CREATE (s)-[:PredicateCreatedLink {name: t.name}]->(t) RETURN s.name, t.name
